summary: 57 units reviewed against the Sanskrit; 23 units marked fix. Issues: 10 error, 23 minor (several 'minor' entries are no-change confirmations of the drafter's doubts: units 3, 31, 39, 41). Errors: unit 39 pitṛ-putra-bhrātṛkāṇām is a bahuvrīhi (-ka), not a dvandva, and the gloss/translations must follow the draft's own note; glossary consistency: kūṭa-yuddha = treacherous warfare (2, 25), avaskanda = assault (3, 19), sattra = ambush position / गुप्त स्थान (15, 18, 24), kārtāntika = fortune-teller (33), vardhaki/mauhūrtika in Hindi (44). Minor: Hindi additions not in the Sanskrit (units 1, 3, 18, 32, 38), Hindi recasting the enemy's state as the king's action (22), modal Hindi for a statement (9), gloss precision (15 aviśvasta, 20 sa-pāda, 24/52 iti), gram labels (43 denominative, 50 causative ppp), notes to record alternatives (23 sarvam, 41 causative, 44 kṛtyā sandhi, 47 genitive agent) and confidence of 47 lowered to medium. The drafter's text_flags (8, 41) are right. No regrouping suggested. Needs a person: unit 31, whether the '|| 31 ||' printed inside the line should get a text_flags entry (the tokens must stay for the checker); unit 39 muṇḍa-anīka stays uncertain. Glossary extended (10.3) with prakāśa-yuddha, bhaṅgaṃ dā-, sauptika, sāra-/phalgu-bala, sūta-māgadha and the four basic array names; existing entries for kūṭa-yuddha, sattra, avaskanda, kārtāntika, senāpati, vyūha were followed.
